items.title: 3 Cash-Heavy Stocks We Think Twice About
items.summary: Companies with more cash than debt can be financially resilient, but that doesn’t mean they’re all strong investments. Some lack leverage because they struggle to grow or generate consistent profits, making them unattractive borrowers.

items.title: DECK Q2 Deep Dive: Product Pipeline and Margins in Focus Amid Shifting Channel Mix
items.summary: Footwear and apparel conglomerate Deckers (NYSE:DECK) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5.7% year on year to $1.02 billion. The company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $5.89 billion at the midpoint. Its GAAP profit of $0.94 per share was 7.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
